title: 第13章 辩论
content_zh:
沈妙是什么样子的？
问起广文馆的学子们，无论是国一，国二亦或是国三，怕都是知晓的。无他，蠢笨，怯懦，偏还要做贞静贤德的模样。
容貌也无甚特别，气质亦不出众，才学无一精通，还是个花痴，痴恋定王满定京城都知道。
所以，若说是广文馆最出众的女子是谁，自然是沈玥，若说最鄙陋的女子是谁，自然是沈妙。
同是沈家女，形象却截然不同。偏偏众人还习惯了沈玥身边那个丫鬟一般的沈妙，有一日沈妙变得不像是沈妙的时候，众人便有些不习惯了。
易佩兰推了推沈玥：“玥娘，你妹妹莫非是病糊涂了，今日怎么像换了个人般？”
沈玥看着沈妙，心中也有些不解。好似从落水醒来后，沈妙的性情便变了不少，莫非是定王之事受了太大打击？她刚想说话，身边的好友江采萱便开了口：“沈妙，听说你落水了，怎么，现在风寒已经好了么？”
这话这么摆在明面上说出来，着实让人难堪，若是往常的沈妙，定会不知所措的看向沈玥，请求沈玥帮自己说话。可今日她只是轻飘飘的看了一眼江采萱，淡淡道：“好了，多谢关怀。”
江采萱一愣，学堂的所有人都跟着一愣。或许是没料到沈妙会这么不冷不热的对自己，江采萱觉得沈妙的态度碍眼极了，立刻道：“既然风寒好了，第一件事不是给定王殿下道歉，却是来学馆，不觉得本末倒置了么？”
沈妙深深吸了一口气，周围的学子无论是少年还是少女，都没有为她说话的意思。她本来就是没有一个朋友的人。而看沈妙出丑，大概是这些贵族子弟们在学馆唯一的乐趣了。

扫了一眼神色各异的众人，再看看沈清眼中的幸灾乐祸，沈妙正要出口，便听得沈玥道：“定王殿下心胸豁达，不会因为这些小事就怪责五妹妹的，五妹妹来学馆，自然是因为求知若渴，是一件好事。”
“什么好事。”另一边的少年却是忍不住笑了起来，他暗地里爱慕沈玥已经许久了，平日里也十分看不上沈妙，觉得有沈妙这么个妹妹简直是沈玥的悲剧。他道：“求知若渴，沈玥，你若是想帮这个妹妹，大可不必用这样的说词，求知若渴……连国一先生的课文都不会念的人，说求知若渴不是太可笑了！况且……”他恶意的打量了一下沈妙，继续道：“谁知道她是不是故意掉下水的，戏文里不都那么演么，掉入水中，英雄救美，以身相许……不过，猜错了结局罢！”说完后，自己大约也觉得有趣，放声大笑起来。
他是这群少年的头头，这么一说话，周围的少年们也跟着哄笑起来。围着沈玥周围的贵女们也觉得好笑，一时间，嘲笑声紧紧围绕着沈妙，落在她身上的目光都是满满的恶意。
言语是最伤人的利器，上辈子，这样的情景不知道出现过多少次。她习惯了被轻视被侮辱被嘲笑，更不愿意主动打破这些固有的概念，最后，沈玥和沈清和这些勋贵儿女们统统交好，而她却越来越远离这个圈子。
她曾以为这就是最大的不幸，可跟上辈子后来那些悲剧比起来，这些算的了什么？这些少年少女，还没有她的婉瑜和傅明大，不过是因为挑拨便势同水火，这些真的就该是她的仇人么？
自然不是的，这些勋贵子女，非富即贵，其中不乏世家大族，而世家大族上辈子落得个什么下场？全都被先皇和傅修宜逐一斩草除根。譬如眼前这位嘲笑她的，沈玥的爱慕者，当今朝奉郎蔡家的大公子蔡霖，几年之后，蔡家因卷入一起贪墨案，不照样被抄了家，蔡霖也被发配充了军。可怜他爱慕了沈玥多年，最后沈玥却巴不得与他划清关系。
她与这些少年少女并不是敌对的关系，有一部分甚至是站在同一边的。只是这些世家因为皇帝的刻意制衡和挑拨，处在微妙的对立面，彼此之间联系并不紧密，甚至算是有些仇怨。
没有必要把同盟变成敌人，上辈子当皇后，沈妙学到了不少东西。不要因为一时意气去树敌，那样太不划算。
“蔡霖，你怎么能这么说五妹妹。”等众人笑够了，沈玥才突然开口：“五妹妹才不是那样的人。”

“蔡霖，”沈妙打断了沈玥的话，语气平平没有一丝起伏：“谁告诉你，我掉下水是因为爱慕定王殿下？”
这么大喇喇的说出来，本是应该令人感到鄙夷的，可沈妙说这话时的沈清坦然，语气也十足淡漠，竟然让众人一愣。
蔡霖是这里的小霸王，平日里沈妙见了他话都不敢多说，何时用过这种质问的语气？而且这语气里不自觉的就带了一丝命令般的询问。蔡霖自己都不知道为什么，竟然没有骂出声，反而道：“难道不是吗？”
“原来是这样的么…。”沈妙自言自语了一句，突然微微笑了，看向沈玥和沈清二人：“大姐姐，二姐姐，他人不知道便罢了，你们也不知道么？怎么也不为妹妹辩解一二？”
沈玥和沈清同时怔了怔，突然想起离开前自家母亲的叮嘱，在沈妙落水这件事情上千万不要说错话。沈清到底比沈玥顾全大局些，立刻道：“是的，你们莫要胡说八道，当时我与五妹妹一道的，我亲眼所见，五妹妹不小心滑入水中，那时恰好定王殿下到了，这才撞见。和爱慕完全无关。”
沈清说的这般笃定，众人虽然不信，却也没有方才那么严肃了。却见沈妙开口道：“非是亲眼所见便妄言，广文堂不仅要教习功课，怕是品德也要一并教养。况且爱慕一言，本是美好之词，为何说的如此不堪？我沈妙爱慕一个人，也要爱慕的有尊严。定王殿下天潢贵胄，哪是我能够肖想的？诸位错了。”
这世上，要想一下子改变印象很难。况且她之前痴恋傅修宜的事天下皆知，现在说不爱，怕没有人会相信。
但无论如何，划清界限总是要有的。
话音未落，便听得一个赞叹的声音响起：“好一个爱慕的有尊严！”
content_en:
What was Shen Miao like?
If you ask the students at Guangwen Hall, whether they are in National One, National Two or National Three, I am afraid they all know it. Without him, he is stupid and cowardly, but he still wants to act chaste, quiet and virtuous.
His appearance is nothing special, his temperament is not outstanding, and he is not proficient in any of his talents or knowledge. He is also a nymphomaniac, and everyone in the capital knows that he is infatuated with King Ding.
Therefore, if we say who is the most outstanding woman in Guangwen Hall, it is naturally Shen Yue; if we are talking about who is the most despicable woman, it is naturally Shen Miao.
Both are daughters of the Shen family, but their images are completely different. However, everyone was still used to the maid-like Shen Miao beside Shen Yue. One day, when Shen Miao no longer looked like Shen Miao, everyone became a little unaccustomed to it.
Yi Peilan pushed Shen Yue: "Yue Niang, is your sister just sick and confused? Why does she seem like a different person today?"
Shen Yue looked at Shen Miao with some confusion in her heart. It seemed that Shen Miao's temperament had changed a lot after she woke up from falling into the water. Could it be that the appointment as king was a big blow? Just as she was about to speak, her friend Jiang Caixuan spoke up: "Shen Miao, I heard that you fell into the water. What, are you feeling better now from the cold?"
It was really embarrassing to say this so openly. If Shen Miao was the usual person, she would definitely look at Shen Yue at a loss and ask Shen Yue to speak for her. But today she just glanced at Jiang Caixuan lightly and said lightly: "Okay, thank you for your concern."
Jiang Caixuan was stunned, and everyone in the school was also stunned. Perhaps she did not expect that Shen Miao would be so lukewarm towards her. Jiang Caixuan felt that Shen Miao's attitude was extremely annoying and immediately said: "Now that the cold is better, the first thing is not to apologize to His Highness King Ding, but to come to the academy. Don't you think you are putting the cart before the horse?"
Shen Miao took a deep breath. None of the students around her, whether they were boys or girls, had the intention to speak for her. She originally had no friends. Watching Shen Miao make a fool of herself was probably the only pleasure these noble disciples had in the academy.

After glancing at the people with different expressions and looking at the gloating in Shen Qing's eyes, Shen Miao was about to speak when she heard Shen Yue say: "His Royal Highness Prince Ding is open-minded and will not blame Fifth Sister for such trivial matters. Fifth Sister came to the academy naturally because she is thirsty for knowledge, which is a good thing."
"What a good thing." The young man on the other side couldn't help laughing. He had been secretly in love with Shen Yue for a long time and usually looked down on Shen Miao. He felt that having a sister like Shen Miao was simply a tragedy for Shen Yue. He said: "I'm thirsty for knowledge, Shen Yue, if you want to help this sister, you don't have to use such words. I'm thirsty for knowledge... It's not ridiculous for someone who can't even read Mr. Guoyi's text to say he's thirsty for knowledge! Besides..." He looked at it maliciously... Shen Miao continued: "Who knows if she fell into the water on purpose? Isn't it like that in dramas? When she falls into the water, the hero saves the beauty and promises her life... But, I guessed the wrong ending!" After saying this, she probably felt it was interesting too and laughed loudly.
He was the leader of this group of teenagers. When he spoke like this, the teenagers around him started laughing. The noble ladies surrounding Shen Yue also felt it was funny. For a moment, Shen Miao was surrounded by ridicule, and the eyes that fell on her were full of malice.
Words are the most hurtful weapon. I don’t know how many times this happened in my last life. She was used to being looked down upon, insulted and laughed at, and she was even more unwilling to take the initiative to break these inherent concepts. In the end, Shen Yue and Shen Qing became friends with these noble sons and daughters, but she became more and more distant from this circle.
She once thought that this was the greatest misfortune, but compared with the tragedies later in her life, what did this mean? These boys and girls are not as big as her Wanyu and Fu Ming, but becauseInstigating power is the same as fire and water. Are these really her enemies?
Of course not. These noble children are either rich or noble, and many of them belong to aristocratic families. And what happened to the aristocratic families in their previous lives? All of them were eradicated one by one by the late Emperor and Fu Xiu Yi. For example, the person in front of her who was laughing at her, Shen Yue's admirer, was Cai Lin, the eldest son of the Cai family. A few years later, the Cai family was involved in a corruption case, and their home was ransacked. Cai Lin was also sent to the army. It's a pity that he has been in love with Shen Yue for many years, but in the end, Shen Yue was eager to cut ties with him.
She is not hostile to these boys and girls, and some of them are even on the same side. It's just that because of the emperor's deliberate checks and balances and provocations, these aristocratic families are on subtle opposite sides, and their connections with each other are not close, and there is even some resentment.
There is no need to turn allies into enemies. Shen Miao learned a lot from being a queen in her previous life. Don't make enemies just because of your anger, it's not worth it.
"Cai Lin, how could you say that to Fifth Sister?" After everyone had laughed enough, Shen Yue suddenly spoke: "Fifth Sister is not that kind of person."
"Cai Lin," Shen Miao interrupted Shen Yue's words, her tone was flat and without any fluctuation: "Who told you that I fell into the water because I admire His Highness Prince Ding?"
Saying it so boldly should make people feel contemptuous, but when Shen Miao said this, Shen Qing was calm and her tone was completely indifferent, which actually made everyone stunned.
Cai Lin was the little bully here. Normally, Shen Miao did not dare to say anything when she saw him. When had she ever used such a questioning tone? And there was a hint of command-like questioning in his tone unconsciously. Cai Lin himself didn't know why, but he didn't curse out loud, but said: "Isn't it?"
"So this is it..." Shen Miao muttered to herself and suddenly smiled slightly, looking at Shen Yue and Shen Qing: "Eldest sister, second sister, it's fine if others don't know, don't you know too? Why don't you defend your sister?"
Shen Yue and Shen Qing were stunned at the same time, and suddenly remembered their mother's instructions before leaving, not to say the wrong thing about Shen Miao falling into the water. Shen Qing was more concerned about the overall situation than Shen Yue, and immediately said: "Yes, don't talk nonsense. I was with the fifth sister at that time. I saw it with my own eyes. The fifth sister accidentally slipped into the water. His Royal Highness Prince Ding arrived at that time, and I bumped into her. It has nothing to do with admiration."
Shen Qing said so confidently that although everyone didn't believe it, they were not as serious as before. But Shen Miao opened her mouth and said, "You can't speak nonsense unless you have seen it with your own eyes. Guangwen Hall must not only teach lessons, but also cultivate moral character. Moreover, the words of love are originally beautiful words, why are they said so badly? I, Shen Miao, love a person, and I must love with dignity. Your Highness, King Ding, Tianhuang, how can I imagine him? You are wrong."
In this world, it is difficult to change your impression all of a sudden. Besides, it was known to the whole world that she was obsessed with Fu Xiu Yi. Now if she says she doesn't love him, no one will believe her.
But no matter what, there are always clear boundaries to draw.
Before he finished speaking, a voice of admiration was heard: "What a dignified person to admire!"
